name.en: National Scholarship Portal One Time Registration (OTR) for ST students, mobile app steps

summary.en: Gives you the OTR number needed to use the National Scholarship Portal

name.en: Mobile number linked to your Aadhaar, plus your Aadhaar number
Mother's name, father's name and an email ID

en: Download the NSP OTR app (by National Informatics Centre) from the Google Play Store. You need a mobile phone, internet and an Aadhaar-linked mobile number.
Tap Register, tick both boxes (read the guidelines; consent to use Aadhaar/OTR for de-duplication), then tap Next.
Enter your mobile number, tap Send OTP, enter the OTP and the captcha, then tap Verify.
Choose 'I have Aadhaar', enter your 12-digit Aadhaar number, tap Send OTP, enter the OTP and captcha, then tap Next.
Check the details shown from Aadhaar, enter your mother's name, father's name and email ID, enter the captcha and tap Next. A reference number is generated.
Log in with the reference number, tap Send OTP, enter the OTP and captcha, tap Next, then tap I Agree.
Tap Proceed for Face Authentication and keep your face inside the circle until it turns green.
Your OTR number is generated and the password is sent to your mobile number. Log in later with the OTR number and password, or with your Aadhaar and an OTP.
Only one OTR is allowed per student. A parent or guardian can generate up to two OTRs for two minor children. A student found with more than one OTR can be debarred from scholarships.

to_confirm: This guide is published by the Tribal Welfare Department, AP, for ST students; screens may change when the app is updated
